basis.prefix: Cluster::new(3, 3) builds three OmniPaxos instances (pids 1,2,3) over shared MemoryStorage handles, then pump_until(2000) ticks/routes until a leader (Leader, Accept) exists; three entries 0,1,2 are appended on that leader and pump_until(4000) waits until every node reports decided_idx == 3. followers are sorted and the two non-leaders are named v (stale node) and f (healthy follower). Case (b): with batch_size 2 it appends TestEntry(0..6) on the leader, waits until all nodes report decided_idx 6, emits leader_change_admitted with the prefix, removes the leader instance, pump_until a new (Leader, Accept) exists, appends TestEntry(200..204) on the new leader, waits until all surviving nodes report decided_idx 10, and emits case_result_leader_change with the new leader's identity, prefix preservation and vector equality; it then rebuilds the old leader from its storage handle and pump_until every node reports decided_idx 10 with equal vectors, emitting case_result_leader_change_recovered. basis.prefix: Cluster::new(3, 3) builds three OmniPaxos instances (pids 1,2,3) over shared MemoryStorage handles, then pump_until(2000) ticks/routes until a leader (Leader, Accept) exists; three entries 0,1,2 are appended on that leader and pump_until(4000) waits until every node reports decided_idx == 3. followers are sorted and the two non-leaders are named v (stale node) and f (healthy follower). Three more entries 10,11,12 are appended on the leader; the driver then routes message by message and inserts v into the mute set the moment get_accepted_idx(v) == 6, so v accepts all six entries while the decision-bearing traffic is dropped for it, while f is allowed to reach decided_idx == 6. The leader then calls trim(Some(6)) (every node has accepted 6, so the trim is legal), the driver waits until get_compacted_idx(f) == 6 (the forwarded Compaction::Trim is delivered to f and the crashed-so-far v is muted so it misses it). The driver then removes the leader from the cluster (crash), unmutes v, and drops only AcceptSync addressed to v so v can promise to the replacement leader without accepting under its ballot; pump_until(4000) waits until f reports get_current_leader() == Some((f, true)). Finally the driver calls v.try_become_leader(), which makes v send Prepare{n: v's promise + 1, decided_idx: 3, n_accepted: r1, accepted_idx: 6} to its peers, and a single route() step delivers that Prepare to f inside catch_unwind; the resulting outcome (completed vs aborted panic, plus panic message and the observed index fields) is printed as a CA_EVENT.
